reason: The plugin intercepts image submission in a chat input, converts images to textual descriptions through a configured vision API, and inserts or sends the resulting context for text-only models; its external data transmission and privileged local execution warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 将粘贴或拖拽的图片通过配置的视觉 API 转换为文字描述，并将描述插入或发送到聊天输入中。
summaries.en: Converts pasted or dragged images into text descriptions through a configured vision API and inserts or sends those descriptions in the chat input.

capabilities: Reads pasted or dragged image data from the browser input
Converts images to text using a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API
Sends image data to a user-configured external endpoint
Runs a Node subprocess with the documented danger-full-access policy
Reads API credentials from plugin settings, configuration files, or environment variables
